build_preprocess_segmentation_images: preprocess images and segmentation maps with Mask2FormerImageProcessor for model input
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post-process Mask2Former model outputs into semantic segmentation maps for each image
post_process_instance_segmentation: post-process Mask2Former model outputs into instance segmentation predictions with RLE or binary maps
post_process_panoptic_segmentation: post-process Mask2Former model outputs into panoptic segmentation with fused background labels
convert_segmentation_to_rle: convert a segmentation map tensor to COCO run-length encoding format
